about: Backhand Rise (katana.k_1l2), the one-handed string's hit 2 (KE task 11): Attack1H04_R's backhand from the left shoulder across to the right, one-handed as the pack keys it, made to rise as Elden Ring's does by the wrist: the tip turned 30-35 degrees low through the wind-up on the left and 20 degrees high through the follow-through, so the cut sweeps up from low on the left to high on the right; the cocked pose held, the strike snapped through, the follow-through held, then back to the guard, the blade 45 degrees lower at either end as the one-handed guard carries it, and turned on where it would pass within 9 cm of the body (the wind-up past the head and the free arm; the game's bodies are fuller than the rig's capsules). A step forward carries the body in. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
